items.title: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization
items.excerpt: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT). This post explores when FFT outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examines the spectral properties of model weight matrices behind the quality gap, shares practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines, and shows how to get started.

items.title: Exa boosts embedding throughput by 50% to index billions of documents on AWS AI chips
items.excerpt: Exa's neural search engine is backed by an in-house vector database, so the unit economics of embedding tens of billions of web documents drive the business. This post shares how Exa optimized embedding inference on AWS Neuron hardware (Inferentia2 and Trainium2) with custom NKI kernels, reaching a 47% gain in performance and cost per million documents.

items.title: Introducing workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.excerpt: Large training jobs can stall or compute wrong results even when every node looks healthy. Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now adds workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks that catch these failures sooner and raise the goodput of your training workloads.

items.title: Introducing the Amazon SageMaker JumpStart Model Leaderboard

items.title: How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock
items.excerpt: Airbnb runs evals on real engineering tasks and uses Amazon Bedrock observability to choose models for its coding agents and control production costs. This post shows how cost per task guides model selection, why production spending can differ from eval results, and how to monitor latency, manage quotas, and attribute spend.

items.title: Design responsible AI controls for Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
items.excerpt: Learn how to make RAG chatbot answers traceable with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, pgvector, and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, logging sources, scores, and guardrail traces in SQL.

items.title: Private certificate authority support in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity

This post shows how to issue an IdP certificate with AWS Private CA, configure a credential provider to trust it, rotate the CA, and protect the certificate.

items.title: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs in a hub-and-spoke network with centralized inspection
